Pharmacy Management System
==========================

HOW TO RUN
----------
1. Keep pharmacy.exe and the data/ folder together in the same folder.
2. Double-click pharmacy.exe. No installation or compiler needed.
3. The app reads/writes its data files in the data/ folder (do not move the exe elsewhere).

REQUIREMENTS
------------
- Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
- That's it — all libraries are statically linked into the exe.

CONTENTS
--------
pharmacy.exe   The application (standalone, ~4 MB)
data/          Data files (medicines, suppliers, sales, history)
               These are created automatically if missing.
